errors.evidence: The figure contains two distinct pie charts, not a single one. The description incorrectly identifies the structure as a single chart.

The description only mentions the purpose of the first chart ('categorized based on the reviewed cases') and completely omits the purpose of the second chart ('Classification by amount of funds spent').
In the left chart (number of reports), the largest segment is 'Провали' (Failures) with 438 reports. 'Некласифицирани' (Unclassified) is the second largest with 340 reports.
The 'Некласифицирани' (Unclassified) segment is colored grey, not blue.
In the left chart, the 'Провали' (Failures) segment is the largest (438 reports), not medium-sized.
The 'Провали' (Failures) segment is colored red, not green.
The 'Успехи' (Successes) segment is colored green, not red.

errors.text_span: Всяка част от диаграмата показва количествена информация за броя на случаите, особено за „Некласифицирани“ с 37,8 млрд. лв., „Провали“ с 82,6 млрд. лв. и „Успехи“ с 35,5 млрд. лв.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly conflates the two charts. It claims to be describing the 'number of cases' but then provides the monetary values (in млрд. лв.) from the second chart.
The value for 'Успехи' (Successes) in the right chart is 35.3 млрд. лв., not 35.5 млрд. лв.
